name: Wavyzon
author: anais.saraiva@ihorizon.org
description:
Standalone audio node for Discord bots, written in Rust: frame-accurate timing (wire clock), two-deck mixing and crossfades, pure-Rust DAVE end-to-end encryption, and Lavalink v4 compatibility so existing Lavalink clients work unchanged.
Built from source at install time: https://gitlab.com/ihrz/wavyzon

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# Wavyzon - build from source in the stock installer image (ghcr.io/pelican-eggs/installers:debian).
# CMake and a C compiler build libopus, which is linked statically; DAVE is pure Rust. The binary only
# needs glibc, libm and libgcc_s at runtime, which the yolks debian/ubuntu images provide (their glibc
# is newer than the installer's bookworm one).
set -e
export DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive

apt-get update
apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends build-essential cmake

# /tmp is a small tmpfs in the Wings install container: build on the server volume instead.
BUILD=/mnt/server/.build
if [ -d "${BUILD}" ]; then chmod -R u+w "${BUILD}"; rm -rf "${BUILD}"; fi
mkdir -p "${BUILD}/tmp"
export TMPDIR="${BUILD}/tmp"
export RUSTUP_HOME="${BUILD}/rustup"
export CARGO_HOME="${BUILD}/cargo"
export CARGO_TARGET_DIR="${BUILD}/target"
export CARGO_INCREMENTAL=0
# Fewer parallel jobs = less RAM. A release build needs ~1.5 GB per job.
export CARGO_BUILD_JOBS="${WAVYZON_BUILD_JOBS:-2}"
export PATH="${CARGO_HOME}/bin:${PATH}"

echo "Installing the Rust toolchain..."
curl --proto '=https' --tlsv1.2 -sSf https://sh.rustup.rs \
    | sh -s -- -y --no-modify-path --profile minimal --default-toolchain stable
cargo --version

REPO="${WAVYZON_REPO}"
if [ -n "${WAVYZON_GIT_TOKEN}" ]; then
    # Private fork: https://oauth2:<token>@gitlab.com/...
    REPO="$(printf '%s' "${REPO}" | sed -E "s#^https://#https://oauth2:${WAVYZON_GIT_TOKEN}@#")"
fi
echo "Cloning ${WAVYZON_REPO} (${WAVYZON_REF})..."
if ! GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT=0 git clone --depth 1 --branch "${WAVYZON_REF}" "${REPO}" "${BUILD}/src"; then
    echo "ERROR: could not clone ${WAVYZON_REPO} at ${WAVYZON_REF}."
    echo "For a private fork, set WAVYZON_GIT_TOKEN (GitLab access token with read_repository)."
    exit 1
fi
cd "${BUILD}/src"
echo "Commit: $(git rev-parse --short HEAD)"

# Build with the stable toolchain installed above instead of adding the components that
# rust-toolchain.toml asks for (rustfmt, clippy).
rm -f rust-toolchain.toml

echo "Building Wavyzon (jobs: ${CARGO_BUILD_JOBS})..."
cargo build --release --locked -p wavyzon --bin wavyzon

echo "Copying files to /mnt/server..."
cp "${CARGO_TARGET_DIR}/release/wavyzon" /mnt/server/wavyzon
chmod +x /mnt/server/wavyzon
cp LICENSE NOTICE /mnt/server/ 2>/dev/null || true
mkdir -p /mnt/server/data /mnt/server/cache
# Leftovers of the previous egg version, which bundled glibc and started through a script.
rm -rf /mnt/server/lib /mnt/server/start.sh

cd /mnt/server
chmod -R u+w "${BUILD}"
rm -rf "${BUILD}"

if [ ! -x /mnt/server/wavyzon ]; then
    echo "Installation failed"
    exit 1
fi

echo "Installation complete."
exit 0

variables.name: Password
variables.description: Shared secret required on every request (Authorization header). Required; 'youshallnotpass' is refused.

variables.name: Git repository
variables.description: Repository built at install time.

variables.name: Branch or tag
variables.description: Branch or tag to build. Reinstall the server to update.

variables.name: Git token (private fork)
variables.description: Optional: the repository is public. GitLab access token (read_repository) only for a private fork.

variables.name: Build jobs
variables.description: Parallel compile jobs during install (~1.5 GB of RAM each). Lower it if the install runs out of memory.

variables.name: Log level
variables.description: debug, info, warn or error.

variables.name: Log format
variables.description: pretty (readable in the console) or json (one JSON line per event, for a log collector).

variables.name: Buffer per deck (ms)
variables.description: Decoded audio buffered per deck (1000-60000).

variables.name: Default Opus bitrate
variables.description: Opus bitrate when the bot sends none (bps, 16000-384000).

variables.name: Playout delay (ms)
variables.description: Measured delay between Discord receiving audio and listeners hearing it, added to audibleAt.

variables.name: Pause/resume fade (ms)
variables.description: 0 = instant pause (0-2000).

variables.name: Resume timeout (s)
variables.description: How long players survive while their client is disconnected.

variables.name: playerUpdate interval (ms)
variables.description: How often playerUpdate is sent (min 250).

variables.name: Search order
variables.description: Sources queried for a text search, in order.

variables.name: Playback sources
variables.description: Sources that actually play audio; tracks from other sources are matched to them by ISRC or title.

variables.name: Prefetch on loadtracks
variables.description: Preload the first result of each search so playback starts instantly.

variables.name: Analysis workers
variables.description: Offline analysis concurrency (1-64).

variables.name: Analysis queue
variables.description: Maximum size of the analysis queue.

variables.name: Audio cache directory
variables.description: Disk cache directory (empty = disabled).

variables.name: Audio cache size (GB)
variables.description: Disk cache limit (1-1000).

variables.name: Loudness normalization
variables.description: Bring every track to the same loudness.

variables.name: Target LUFS
variables.description: Loudness target (-30 to -5).

variables.name: State file
variables.description: Sessions are saved here on shutdown and resumed after a restart (empty = disabled).

variables.name: HTTP source
variables.description: Play direct audio links (MP3, FLAC...) and Icecast/Shoutcast radios.

variables.name: HTTP: private addresses
variables.description: Let the HTTP source reach the local network (10.x, 192.168.x, 127.0.0.1...). Keep false unless every client is trusted.

variables.name: Local files directory
variables.description: Directory local tracks may be played from, e.g. /home/container/music (empty = disabled).

variables.name: Plugins
variables.description: Comma-separated plugins to enable (empty = every compiled-in plugin).

variables.name: Deezer enabled
variables.description: Deezer search, links and playback.

variables.name: Deezer ARL
variables.description: Comma-separated Deezer account ARL cookies. Without them Deezer is metadata only.

variables.name: Deezer ARL rotation
variables.description: failover, round-robin or random when several ARLs are set.

variables.name: Deezer master key
variables.description: Deezer master key. Required with DEEZER_ARL for Deezer playback.

variables.name: Deezer high quality
variables.description: Ask for 128 kbit/s MP3 (falling back to 64) instead of 64 only.

variables.name: Spotify client ID
variables.description: Spotify Web API credentials (metadata only). Without them Spotify links don't resolve.

variables.name: Spotify client secret
variables.description: Spotify Web API secret.

variables.name: Apple Music storefront
variables.description: Apple Music catalogue storefront.

variables.name: SoundCloud enabled
variables.description: SoundCloud search and playback.

variables.name: Cache peers
variables.description: Other Wavyzon nodes to share the disk cache with, comma-separated URLs (empty = disabled).

variables.name: Shared cache secret
variables.description: Same secret on every node; required by WAVYZON_CACHE_PEERS.

variables.name: Automatic crossfade (ms)
variables.description: Fade into the queued nextTrack before the current track ends (0-12000, 0 = strict gapless).

variables.name: Lyrics (lyrics.ovh)
variables.description: Serve lyrics from lyrics.ovh on /v4/lyrics (LavaLyrics API).
